channel.title: AI GridWatch — New York data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for New York, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: East Fishkill: data center moratorium — Enacted
Islip: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month ban on new data center facilities; second Long Island town after Brookhaven

item.title: Brookhaven: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium, unanimous after nearly 6 hours of public hearings; town code doesn't currently define data centers. First Long Island town to act

item.title: Lysander (Onondaga Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month; no applications accepted by Town, Planning or Zoning boards

item.title: Perth (Fulton Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
Tonawanda (Erie Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Local Law 2-2026: 1-year pause on facilities drawing 20 MW or more — a lower threshold than the state EO's 50 MW

item.title: Newfield (Tompkins Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year townwide pause on data processing centers and cryptocurrency mining; town is drafting comprehensive-plan amendments before it lapses

item.title: St. Lawrence County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: The county did not adopt a moratorium of its own — it passed a resolution affirming local zoning authority and urging its municipalities to consider one. Tracked as a signal, not a restriction

item.title: Mohawk (Montgomery Co.): data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 6-month pause to write zoning rules; public hearing Aug 13, 2026. Supervisor cites the state EO's 50 MW floor as leaving smaller facilities unregulated. Would run to Feb 13, 2027 if adopted

item.title: New York (statewide): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: EO 62: first statewide pause. Holds DEC discretionary approvals for 50+ MW facilities until DPS finishes a generic environmental impact statement — roughly a year, but tied to that study, not a fixed date

item.title: New York (S10642/A11560): data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Responsible Data Center Development Act: 1-year moratorium on state permits for 20+ MW facilities, plus a dedicated utility rate class, a DEC impact study, and a host-community benefit program. Passed the Senate 43-17. Per the Senate's own record it had not been delivered to the Governor as of Aug 4, 2026 — Hochul acted by executive order (EO 62, 50 MW floor) instead. Still live, and stricter than the EO
